answer: No MCP yet, but not written off. First consumers are me from a shell and the Emacs plugin; agents come through the same CLI. The operator is JSON-intolerant (c-json-intolerant), so the contract is line-oriented text by default and JSON only as an opt-in encoding.
body: zmx already gives an agent run/send/tail/wait/history/set. What zmux would add: a stable session list, name allocation without collisions, wait-with-timeout returning the exit code, and a label vocabulary the agent is told to use. Open: which agent here is the first consumer, and does it need a CLI or an MCP-shaped tool?
title: What is the program surface, and who is the first program?
